statement:
The invoice record shows conflicting information where it is marked as both paid in full and unpaid, which makes the recorded value unsafe and incorrect for payment. 

I have found an inconsistency in the records: invoice 88412 is marked as both "paid in full" on September 3rd and "unpaid, due" for September 30th. Because of this conflict, I cannot proceed with the payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the record's status is "unsafe and incorrect for payment" due to the contradiction of being both "paid in full" and "unpaid, due," and refuses to pay.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
